Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

In this session, we will discuss Lagrange's linear equation and working rule to solve Lagrange's linear equation.

Key details

  • The linear first order partial differential equation of the form capital P of XYZ times small p plus q of xyz q equals r of xyz.
  • And this expression is called Lagrangius equation in two independent variables, namely x and y.
  • There are three steps in the procedure.
  • Then we write axillary equation in this form.
  • Remember there are three ways to solve this axillary equation.
  • One is by method of grouping, second by method of multipliers, and the third is the differential concept.
  • We write the general solution in the form φ of u comma v equals 0.
  • So remember we will solve the axillary equations by the method of grouping or method of multipliers or both to get two independent solutions, namely u equals a and u equals b where ab are arbitrary constants.
  • So what is method of grouping in Lagrange's method?
  • So how do we apply method of grouping for a problem?
  • So once we finish writing XL equation, if we want to apply method of grouping, we will write two ratios at a time like this.
  • It could be dx by capital P equals Dy by Q or Dy by capital Q equals dz by R, Dx by B equal DZ by R.
  • So it is first and second ratio, or this is second and third ratio, or this is first and last ratio.
  • So if integration is possible, after separating the variables, we say that method of grouping works.
  • And R is that.
  • It is easy to see that the variables have already been separated.
  • So from the first and second, we can write.

Example or application from the lecture

  • Remember the general solution of Lagrangian's linear equation is given by pi of u comma v equals zero where phi is an arbitrary function.
  • And U and V are the two linearly independent solutions of the acceler equation which is given by Tx divided by capital P equals dy by capital Q equals dz by R.
  • After understanding Lagrange's linear equation and its general solution, let's look at the working rule to solve Lagrange's linear equation.
